news.title: US stocks today: S&P, Nasdaq soar 1% at open as easing oil prices boost Fed hike relief
news.description: US stocks opened higher on Thursday as falling oil prices improved investor sentiment following the Federal Reserve's first rate hike under Chair Kevin Warsh. The Dow rose 0.82%, the S&P 500 gained 1.05% and the Nasdaq climbed 1.54% at the open, extending gains across major indexes.
